verdict.rationale: NVIDIA publishes 32 GB of GDDR7 VRAM, and Tom's Hardware confirms a 512-bit bus. First-party docs claim FP4 Tensor Core support and LLM inference acceleration, and community Llama.cpp benchmarks show the card running local LLM workloads. However, no memory bandwidth figure is published, and nothing in the evidence shows a 70B-class quantized model fitting in or running on the 32 GB card. Missing for 10: a published memory bandwidth figure (GB/s), evidence that a 70B-class quantized model fits and runs on a single card, and hands-on tokens/sec results for that model class.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a 70B-class quantized LLM on this GPU — published VRAM capacity and memory bandwidth that make local or single-node inference practical
